# openwebui_images_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's image generation and image editing engines: OpenAI, Automatic1111, ComfyUI, and Gemini.

`POST /api/v1/images/config/update` writes every key it receives, so this resource reads the current configuration and overlays the attributes the plan names before it writes. A successful apply does not prove the engine is reachable: the update route asks Automatic1111 to load the model and swallows the error when the host does not answer.

`user.permissions` is in the router's key map but not in its form, so this router never touches user permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A successful apply does not prove the engine answers. The update route asks
# Automatic1111 to load the model and swallows the error when the host is down.
resource "openwebui_images_config" "example" {
  enable_image_generation = true
  image_generation_engine = "openai"
  image_generation_model  = "dall-e-3"
  image_size              = "1024x1024"
  image_steps             = 50
  images_openai_api_key   = var.openai_api_key

  enable_image_edit = false
}

variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `automatic1111_api_auth` (String, Sensitive) Automatic1111 credentials as `user:password`. Open WebUI base64-encodes them at call time. Stored as `image_generation.automatic1111.api_auth`. Sensitive.
- `automatic1111_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `AUTOMATIC1111_BASE_URL`. Stored as `image_generation.automatic1111.base_url`.
- `automatic1111_params` (String) JSON object of extra parameters passed to Automatic1111. Stored as `image_generation.automatic1111.api_params`.
- `comfyui_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `COMFYUI_API_KEY`. Stored as `image_generation.comfyui.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `comfyui_base_url` (String) Base URL of the ComfyUI server. Open WebUI strips leading and trailing slashes before it stores the value, and Terraform keeps the form the configuration wrote. Stored as `image_generation.comfyui.base_url`.
- `comfyui_workflow` (String) Open WebUI setting `COMFYUI_WORKFLOW`. Stored as `image_generation.comfyui.workflow`.
- `comfyui_workflow_nodes` (String) JSON array of ComfyUI workflow node bindings. Stored as `image_generation.comfyui.nodes`.
- `enable_image_edit` (Boolean) Open WebUI setting `ENABLE_IMAGE_EDIT`. Stored as `images.edit.enable`.
- `enable_image_generation` (Boolean) Open WebUI setting `ENABLE_IMAGE_GENERATION`. Stored as `image_generation.enable`.
- `enable_image_prompt_generation` (Boolean) Open WebUI setting `ENABLE_IMAGE_PROMPT_GENERATION`. Stored as `image_generation.prompt.enable`.
- `image_edit_engine` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGE_EDIT_ENGINE`. Stored as `images.edit.engine`.
- `image_edit_model` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGE_EDIT_MODEL`. Stored as `images.edit.model`.
- `image_edit_size` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGE_EDIT_SIZE`. Stored as `images.edit.size`.
- `image_generation_engine` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGE_GENERATION_ENGINE`. Stored as `image_generation.engine`.
- `image_generation_model` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGE_GENERATION_MODEL`. Stored as `image_generation.model`.
- `image_size` (String) Generated image size, `WIDTHxHEIGHT`, or `auto`, or the empty string. Open WebUI accepts `auto` only for models its `IMAGE_AUTO_SIZE_MODELS_REGEX_PATTERN` matches. Stored as `image_generation.size`.
- `image_steps` (Number) Diffusion steps per image. Must not be negative. Stored as `image_generation.steps`.
- `images_edit_comfyui_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_EDIT_COMFYUI_API_KEY`. Stored as `images.edit.comfyui.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `images_edit_comfyui_base_url` (String) Base URL of the ComfyUI server used for image editing. Open WebUI strips leading and trailing slashes before it stores the value, and Terraform keeps the form the configuration wrote. Stored as `images.edit.comfyui.base_url`.
- `images_edit_comfyui_workflow` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_EDIT_COMFYUI_WORKFLOW`. Stored as `images.edit.comfyui.workflow`.
- `images_edit_comfyui_workflow_nodes` (String) JSON array of ComfyUI workflow node bindings used for image editing. Stored as `images.edit.comfyui.nodes`.
- `images_edit_gemini_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_EDIT_GEMINI_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `images.edit.gemini.api_base_url`.
- `images_edit_gemini_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_EDIT_GEMINI_API_KEY`. Stored as `images.edit.gemini.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `images_edit_openai_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_EDIT_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `images.edit.openai.api_base_url`.
- `images_edit_openai_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_EDIT_OPENAI_API_KEY`. Stored as `images.edit.openai.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `images_edit_openai_api_version` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_EDIT_OPENAI_API_VERSION`. Stored as `images.edit.openai.api_version`.
- `images_gemini_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_GEMINI_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `image_generation.gemini.api_base_url`.
- `images_gemini_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_GEMINI_API_KEY`. Stored as `image_generation.gemini.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `images_gemini_endpoint_method` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_GEMINI_ENDPOINT_METHOD`. Stored as `image_generation.gemini.endpoint_method`.
- `images_openai_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `image_generation.openai.api_base_url`.
- `images_openai_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_OPENAI_API_KEY`. Stored as `image_generation.openai.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `images_openai_api_params` (String) JSON object of extra parameters passed to the OpenAI image API. Stored as `image_generation.openai.params`.
- `images_openai_api_version` (String) Open WebUI setting `IMAGES_OPENAI_API_VERSION`. Stored as `image_generation.openai.api_version`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this singleton resource. Always `images`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Open WebUI holds one image-generation configuration, so this resource is a
# singleton. Import it under its fixed id.
terraform import openwebui_images_config.example images
```
